annotations.title: Find creators who look like the customer

description: Starts a search for real creators who look like the brand's customers, on TikTok, Instagram (Reels), YouTube or LinkedIn (TikTok unless `platforms` names others), judged from their own bio and posts, active in the last 30 days, with posts that get watched (typical views at least 0.3x followers on TikTok; each platform has its own bar). Only exact fits are returned, each with the quoted evidence for every must-have. Returns at once with a job_id and instant matches: creators CxB already checked that look like the brief. A fresh search graded against the exact must-haves follows, usually within 2 minutes: call get_job right away, it waits for the result. Runs on the user's CxB account (the link this AI was connected with): 3 free searches, up to 5 creators each; Solo ($27/month) and Pro ($97/month) are unlimited searches under a fair-use window (3 and 10 fresh searches every 5 hours). Without an account it returns only the creators already checked and a signup link to give the user. Out of free searches, or asking for a paid plan the account isn't on, it returns a Stripe payment link tied to the account; the plan turns on within a minute of paying. Use it when the brief is about who the creator is, not just a topic or follower count. The full list with each creator's contact is emailed to the account's address.

country.description: Only if the user named a country. A preference: creators there rank first, but it isn't required. To require it, add it to must (e.g. "lives in the US").

max_matches.description: At most this many exact fits. Capped by the plan.

must.description: Requirements every match must show, e.g. ["works nights"]. Default: everything in `who`.

nice.description: Preferences that rank a creator higher but aren't required, e.g. ["B2B software"]. Moving a requirement here can multiply the matches.

plan.description: free (default): 3 searches per account, up to 5 creators each. solo ($27/month) and pro ($97/month): unlimited searches, fair use 3 or 10 fresh searches every 5 hours. A subscriber's searches run on their plan by themselves; pick a paid plan only when the user asked for it, and it returns the payment link for their account.

platforms.description: Where to search: any of "tiktok", "instagram" (Reels), "youtube", "linkedin", or "all". Default ["tiktok"]. With several, the matches are shared out across them.

product_url.description: The product's website, if the user gave one.

who.description: Who the creators should be, in plain words: "ER nurses who work nights", "account executives at SaaS companies", "parents of kids with food allergies".
